models/detail_atlas_axis.glb.source: Regions on the Valchanov CT atlas/axis (CC BY 4.0), written by 03 Testing & Review/(C) detail_bones_2026-11-19/regions.py, 2026-11-19
models/detail_atlas_axis.glb.method: Joint surfaces from contact between the two bones (atlas/axis facets, facet for dens) and with C3 of the main model (axis inferior articular processes); arches, processes, tubercles, body, dens by position within the bone; foramina as the surface lining each opening (canal or tunnel axis found by slicing). Checked by rendered views of every region.
models/detail_atlas_axis.glb.sources: StatPearls NBK539734 (Cervical Vertebrae, Oct 2023; read 2026-11-19); O'Rahilly Basic Human Anatomy ch.39 (Dartmouth; read 2026-11-19); positions also as NBK525969 for the axis parts (2026-11-11). Facts only, no wording copied.

models/detail_clavicle.glb.source: Regions on the Valchanov CT clavicle ("Shoulders", CC BY 4.0), written by 03 Testing & Review/(C) detail_bones_2026-11-25/(C) regions_clavicle.py, 2026-11-25
models/detail_clavicle.glb.method: Each area grown from the card's verified landmark point (snapped to the scan) under a rule from the source descriptions: ends by position along the bone, impressions/grooves by facing (inferior surface) and third of the bone, tubercles within 6 mm of the point. Checked on rendered views of every area.
models/detail_clavicle.glb.sources: StatPearls NBK525990 (Clavicle) and O'Rahilly Basic Human Anatomy (Dartmouth), as for the landmark points (2026-11-11); deltoid tubercle single-source (print check open). Facts only, no wording copied.
